body.message: This key has received its 1 rows for Cashland this month — 10% of 10 locations (max 50). Free (Sandbox) keys get real rows: 10% of each brand's published locations (at most 50 rows per brand) and 1,000 in total per month; every filter, radius and page counts. Pro (Early Access) ($99/month) raises that to 25% of each brand's published locations (at most 250 rows per brand) and 25,000 per month. The complete file is a dataset purchase, and buyers get full API access to the brands they bought. Budgets reset October 1, 2026 (UTC).
